CHALDEAN-MASTER-001.say: Master numbers bring powerful positives and negatives; they can mean difficulty but also great strength.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-002.say: Master 11 is the master of intuition: you are spiritual with an interest in the occult, yet analytical and logical. Independent, courageous and moral, you are a natural leader and a support for others.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-003.say: You are sensitive, empathetic and trusting, and that trust can get you hurt. A loyal, romantic partner, you will not compromise until you find the perfect match.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-004.say: You have strong intuition and should follow your gut, but you can be a dreamer rather than a doer. Take care of overthinking, which can bring stress and frequent anxiety attacks.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-005.say: Master 22 is the master builder: generous and always improving, you build for yourself and others. You are both a dreamer and a doer, confident and responsible.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-007.say: You are intelligent, a perfectionist, optimistic and hard-working, and you finish what you start. You are considered very lucky, which can make others jealous, and a balanced life tends to come later.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-008.say: Take care of aggression and impulsiveness, and of your anger, which can be hard for you to control.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-009.say: Master 33 is the master of spirituality: nurturing, kind and compassionate, you help everyone and share your knowledge. A human magnet with hidden creative genius, you trust easily and can get hurt.

CHALDEAN-MASTER-010.say: Take care not to judge others silently or feel superior. Over-attachment can bring panic and anxiety attacks.
